title: Triage record
description: A reviewed false-positive record. This is the only way a false-positive label clears a finding: labels written into result files are not accepted, and a PR cannot triage the findings it introduces (the base-branch records are what a PR is evaluated against).

finding_fingerprint.description: The finding's `secret_digest` when present, otherwise its stable id. Revalidation is automatic: when the matched content changes, the fingerprint no longer matches and the finding returns.

file.description: The finding's file, without a line number. A record scoped to one file cannot clear the same rule in another.

reason.description: Why this is a false positive (a test value, an example key, a documentation sample). At least 20 characters: a bare label is not triage.
